verdict.rationale: Luma is a generative-video SaaS and API platform, so an official MCP server is a plausible offering and the axis applies. The evidence shows a REST API, Python/JS/TS SDKs, an llms.txt file, Luma Agents and Luma Skills, but nothing documents an official MCP server or MCP endpoint. Those other items are adjacent developer building blocks and earn no credit for this story.
